API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIPolicy ResourcesIP Group Z Resource Get IP Group By ID
IP Group Z Resource Get IP Group By ID
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/ipGroups/:ipGroupId

Retrieves an IP pool based on the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
ipGroupId
int32
REQUIRED

The IP group ID.

Responses
​
default

default response

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

ID of the IP address group or IP pool.

name
string

Name of the IP address group or IP pool.

ipAddresses
string[]

IP addresses included in the IP group or IP pool.

description
string

Description of the IP group or IP pool.

creatorContext
string

Indicates whether the IP group or IP pool is created in Cloud & Branch Connector (EC) or ZIA.

Possible values: [ZIA, EC]

isNonEditable
boolean

Indicates if the IP group is view-only (true) or is editable (false).
